thesis: Amazon's scale comes from retail, but its economics are increasingly powered by high-value services layered on top of that ecosystem, especially AWS, third-party seller services, advertising, and subscriptions.

facts.claim: Amazon reported $716.924 billion in consolidated net sales for 2025, up 12% year over year.
AWS generated $128.725 billion of 2025 net sales and $45.606 billion of operating income, while Amazon's consolidated operating income was $79.975 billion.

In 2025 Amazon reported $269.287 billion from online stores, $172.162 billion from third-party seller services, $68.635 billion from advertising services, and $49.619 billion from subscription services.
Amazon defines service sales as including third-party seller commissions and fulfillment or shipping fees, AWS, advertising services, Prime membership fees, and certain digital subscriptions.
More than 60% of sales in Amazon's store come from independent sellers, most of which are small and medium-sized businesses.
In Q2 2026 Amazon reported AWS net sales of $42.2 billion, up 37% year over year, and described that as a $169 billion annualized revenue run rate.
Amazon's advertising business includes sponsored ads, display advertising, and video advertising offered to sellers, vendors, publishers, authors, and others.
Amazon Retail Ad Service extends Amazon's advertising technology to participating retailers outside Amazon's own store and is built on AWS.

verified_numbers.context: Share of Amazon store sales from independent sellers

timeline.event: Amazon opened its store to independent sellers.
Amazon reached $716.924 billion in annual net sales; AWS reached $128.725 billion.
Independent sellers accounted for more than 60% of sales in Amazon's store.
AWS quarterly net sales reached $42.2 billion, up 37% year over year.

risk_flags: Do not claim retail is unprofitable; Amazon reports profitable North America and International segments in 2025.
Do not describe AWS operating income as Amazon's net profit; it is segment operating income.
Any percentage comparing AWS revenue with consolidated sales or AWS operating income with consolidated operating income should be described as an approximate derived share.
Do not imply seller fees, advertising, or Prime revenue are pure profit; source figures are revenue, not margins.
